# DragonBot

> DragonBot is an Amazon MCP server and AI operator for Amazon sellers. It connects a Seller Central
> account over the official Amazon Selling Partner API and continuously ETLs its data, so Claude,
> ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client can answer questions about the account — and, on the paid tier,
> act on it. Read-only access is free forever.

## Core facts
- Product: Amazon MCP server and AI operator for Amazon sellers.
- Free forever plan: $0/month. Read-only access, every skill, no credit card required.
- Read + Write plan: $50/month. Adds write operations on Seller Central — pause campaigns, issue
  refunds, edit listings — with a supervised approval-gated mode, an autonomous mode for routine
  actions, and a full audit trail. Currently in private beta.
- Never priced as a percentage of your revenue or your ad spend.
- Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP client.
- Amazon connection: the official Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) over OAuth. DragonBot is an
  authorized Amazon SP-API application. No scraping.
- Data covered: orders, advertising, inventory, search query performance, reviews, buyer messages,
  account health.
- Company: Chacha Advisory LLC, 30 N Gould St Ste R, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA.
- Website: https://getdragonbot.com — sign-up: https://app.getdragonbot.com/sign-up

## Core pages
- [Product overview](https://getdragonbot.com/): what DragonBot does, end to end
- [Pricing](https://getdragonbot.com/pricing/): the free tier and the paid write tier
- [Amazon MCP server](https://getdragonbot.com/amazon-mcp/): connecting Amazon to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor
- [Comparisons](https://getdragonbot.com/vs/ai-operators/): versus other AI agents for Amazon sellers
- Sibling products from the same company: [Dragon Refunds](https://dragonrefunds.com) (FBA
  reimbursement recovery) and [Dragon Reply](https://dragonreply.ai) (Buyer-Seller Messaging inbox)

## What it is not
- Not an Amazon product; not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.
- Not a scraper and not a browser extension — official SP-API only.
- Not a done-for-you agency: it is software you connect to your own Seller Central account.
- Not priced as a percentage of revenue, ad spend, or recovered money.
